title: ArcticDB library `universe` — column/dtype/index contract
description: Pinned CONSUMER copy, owned by crucible-executor (alpha-engine-config-I10796 / data_collection_plan_260914.md P-27, which also pins a copy in crucible for v2's data.daily under the same source library). Producer: nousergon-data ArcticDB store + builders (store/arctic_store.py, builders/daily_append.py) writing s3://alpha-engine-research/arcticdb/, library `universe`. Not a per-S3-object JSON Schema — this documents the per-symbol frame shape ArcticDB serves, matching data_collection_plan_260914.md §4.1's 'column/dtype/index contract, pinned in crucible' pattern extended to crucible-executor as the trader's own pin. Reader: executor/price_cache.py (`_open_universe_library` -> `nousergon_lib.arcticdb.open_universe_lib`, `load_price_histories`, `load_atr_14_pct`) and executor/signal_reader.py (`filter_buy_candidates_to_universe` via `universe_lib.list_symbols()`). RECONCILED 2026-09-14 against the producer's own nousergon-data/contracts/arctic_universe.schema.json (P-07, nousergon-data-PR1711, 2ef120fb), which now exists; a byte-verbatim copy is kept at tests/contracts/producer/arctic_universe.schema.json and held in agreement by tests/test_contract_producer_parity.py. The five OHLCV columns agree. ONE DECLARED DIVERGENCE, asserted by that test rather than silently absorbed: the producer's contract is additionalProperties:false and declares NEITHER atr_14_pct NOR VWAP, both of which this repo reads and the first of which load_atr_14_pct hard-fails without — so a frame valid against the producer's published contract is one the morning planner refuses. That gap is in the producer's contract, is tracked upstream, and is the reason this file is not replaced by the producer's copy.

atr_14_pct.staleness_contract: most-recent row must be within 1 trading day of reference_date, or load_atr_14_pct hard-fails (executor.price_cache._ATR_MAX_STALENESS_TRADING_DAYS)

membership.list_symbols: universe_lib.list_symbols() -- read by executor/signal_reader.py::filter_buy_candidates_to_universe as the ArcticDB-side membership check on the morning planner's buy_candidates
membership.excludes: SPY/VIX/VIX3M/TNX/IRX/GLD/USO/XL*-sector-ETFs route to the separate `macro` library (Close-only), not `universe` -- see executor/price_cache.py::_MACRO_SYMBOLS

hard_fail_on: any requested ticker missing the atr_14_pct column (load_atr_14_pct)
any requested ticker's most-recent row older than 1 trading day (load_atr_14_pct)
degrade_on: individual ticker read errors in load_price_histories are surfaced as a RuntimeError naming the failed tickers (not silently dropped)
an empty frame for a ticker is omitted with an INFO log, not a hard fail (load_price_histories)
